claims: Obtain stat 12-lead ECG to evaluate for ischemia in the setting of tachycardia (HR up to 145 bpm), anemia, and elevated lactate.
Check serial troponin and repeat lactate to assess for myocardial ischemia and ongoing hypoperfusion.
Repeat basic metabolic panel and whole blood potassium within 6 hours to monitor hyperkalemia (K 5.1 mEq/L) and metabolic acidosis (bicarbonate 18 mEq/L, anion gap 19).
Recheck hemoglobin/hematocrit and coagulation profile (PTT 114.5 sec, INR 1.5) to monitor anemia and coagulopathy on heparin infusion.
Continue continuous cardiac monitoring and telemetry for tachycardia and arrhythmia surveillance.
Maintain heparin infusion per protocol and monitor aPTT to ensure therapeutic anticoagulation.
Monitor strict intake and output and daily weights given elevated BUN (32 mg/dL) and creatinine (1 mg/dL).
Perform bedside point-of-care glucose monitoring and continue insulin coverage as ordered for hyperglycemia (glucose 143 mg/dL).
Assess and document neurologic status including CAM-ICU each shift given fluctuating mental status and Richmond-RAS +1.
Implement fall precautions and assist with mobility given history of falls, walker use, and bedfast activity level.
